about_the_game:
Villa Nocturne blends classic horror elements with a modern narrative to deliver a tense survival experience. Players step into a dark mansion filled with mysterious notes, haunting sounds, and supernatural entities, where every corner hides a secret waiting to be uncovered.

Explore shadowy corridors, follow cryptic clues, unlock hidden rooms, and face the terrors that escalate with every step. With atmospheric lighting, detailed environment design, and immersive soundscapes, Villa Nocturne draws players into the heart of a chilling nightmare.

This is not just a story of survival—it is a journey through layers of secrets hidden in every detail. As you progress, you will confront not only the ghosts of the past but also your own fears.

・Atmospheric survival experience: Wander through dark hallways, hold your breath when the lights go out, and face the lurking horrors in the shadows.
・Puzzles and exploration: Collect clues across the mansion, unlock forbidden areas, and come closer to uncovering the truth.
・Intense suspense and terror: Sudden doors slamming, unexpected jumpscares, and scenes that play with the player’s psychology.
・Deep storytelling: Piece together fragments of a dark past, but only those who endure to the end will discover the final truth.

Villa Nocturne is not only horror—it is a story of regret, loss, and confronting the unknown.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of blood and violence, depictions of corpses, accidental deaths, and injuries. The dark and oppressive atmosphere includes horror elements and jumpscares that may be disturbing to some players. Certain scenes also imply the use of alcohol or tobacco.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)/Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: In a mansion shrouded in mist, face the ghosts of the past. With puzzles, exploration, and moments of sheer terror, Villa Nocturne awaits.
